text:
What is meant by the power of an engine?
A
the energy that the engine transfers per unit time
B
the maximum force that the engine can exert
C
the maximum weight that the engine can lift
D
the total energy that the engine transfers

options.label: A
options.text: the energy that the engine transfers per unit time

options.label: B
options.text: the maximum force that the engine can exert

options.label: C
options.text: the maximum weight that the engine can lift

options.label: D
options.text: the total energy that the engine transfers
